summary: Plan v4 (Hilbert-adequacy-bridge). Phases 1-7 landed (sorry-free, axiom-clean, unregressed). Phase 8 (Hilbert-labelled adequacy bridge) is [BLOCKED]: a Simpson Ch.6 source pass found the faithful tree-depth-indexed translation is 300-600+ lines, and two simplified shortcuts were tried and machine-refuted (re-boxing an assumption; case-splitting a disjunction under a box are both impossible in any normal modal Hilbert system). Per the plan's own contingency, work pivoted to Phase 11 (fallback route PD). PD.1 (bot_backward/bot_iff_edge/bot_iff_TClosure) landed sorry-free/axiom-clean. PD.2's motive, as literally stated in the plan/report 04, was found unprovable (bare monotonicity has no witness for efq's adversarial dangling label on a non-directed Preorder); a corrected design (exact-agreement Dom(G,Γ,φ):=G.X∪ctxLabels Γ∪{φ.lbl} + caller-supplied protect-set T) was worked out by hand and verified against 11 of 12 NIK constructors, but PD.3's efq residual (pinned conclusion label, disconnected ⊥-premise) is confirmed genuinely open (independently re-derived, not assumed) -- Simpson's own 'unavoidable non-tree excursion' (Sec 8.1.2). Because NIK's induction is one closed Lean match over all 12 constructors, PD.2 cannot be landed as a buildable sorry-free artifact while PD.3 is open. Phase 11 is marked [BLOCKED] per the plan's own sanctioned terminal. No sorry, no new axiom, build green.

blockers.description: Phase 8 (Hilbert-labelled adequacy bridge, nik_TS5_to_hilbert): the faithful Simpson Ch.6 tree-depth-indexed translation is a genuinely large undertaking (300-600+ lines, no existing tree/subtree infrastructure in the codebase); two simplified flattened-translation shortcuts were tried and machine-refuted this dispatch cycle (re-boxing an unboxed hypothesis across labels is unsound in any normal modal logic; case-splitting a disjunction under a box is not a theorem of K or its extensions, confirmed by a two-point countermodel). Not attempted further; sanctioned pivot to Phase 11 per the plan's own contingency.

Phase 11 PD.3 (efq ⊥-locality lemma): confirmed genuinely open. When NIK.efq's conclusion label y is 'pinned' (y in the tracked domain, so the existential witness's value at y is forced to equal the original interpretation) and the premise's bot-label is either dangling or r-disconnected from y, there is no available mechanism to transport botForces across the disconnection under cs5FCIncest + CKValidFC's explosion conditions. This is Simpson's own acknowledged 'unavoidable non-tree excursion' (Sec 8.1.2, chunk 0158), for which he routes around via L_m/Hilbert rather than closing directly in N_IK. Report 04's own confidence (~35%) is unraised by this dispatch's independent re-derivation; closing it would need a new cut-admissibility/normalization-style invariant for N_IK(T) -- research-scale, not transcription.

Corrected report 04 Finding 4's claim that orE needs 'no coordination' under the existential motive -- found this understates the true requirement (a caller-supplied protect-set T is needed for orE's shared minor-premise/conclusion label), though the coordination IS mechanically resolvable.

Recommended a replan choice between (a) committing to the Hilbert bridge's full tree-recursive construction (Phase 8, ~70% per report 04, 300-600+ lines) or (b) treating PD.3's efq gap as requiring dedicated cut-admissibility research before further Phase 11 implementation.
